sections.heading: 1. Movement, strength, balance
lines: ① Knee to wall rocks: 10–15 slow reps.
② Calf stretch off a step: hold 30 sec.
④ Single-leg balance: 30 sec, compare sides.

slides.heading: Worth getting checked if

caption:
Sprained your ankle months ago and it still feels stiff? Like Toto, many people stop rehab once the pain eases, before full movement comes back.

Try the knee to wall test: foot about 10 cm from the wall, heel down, bend your knee to touch it, then compare sides. A big difference suggests there's movement worth getting back.

Start with slow knee to wall rocks, 10–15 reps a few times a day, then add calf raises and single-leg balance to rebuild control.

An ankle that keeps giving way, stays swollen or locks is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐰
